subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor this folder-backed encrypted snapshot config and CLI surface once the safety and proof blockers are fixed, or should the remaining backup direction be narrowed or routed outside core?
rationale: The PR adds persistent config, command API, encrypted credential/state backup, and destructive restore behavior; repository policy treats config/default surfaces and state restoration as compatibility and security-sensitive, and related backup issues are already marked for product and security review.

options.title: Continue After Blockers
options.body: Keep this PR open as the candidate native local-snapshot branch, but require the security fixes, rebase, upgrade story, and real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Archive Hardening
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that only improves the existing backup create/verify safety behavior, leaving new snapshot config and restore UX for later.

options.title: Route Optional Backup Extensions Out
options.body: Close or pause the native snapshot direction and route off-machine or provider-specific backup behavior to ClawHub/plugin work until core APIs are clearer.

recommendation.title: Continue After Blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open as the candidate native local-snapshot branch, but require the security fixes, rebase, upgrade story, and real CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent backup docs/stream-cleanup history and broad state/storage review context, making them the best available routing owner for the core product decision.
